base_prompt:
A high-end stylised 3D animated feature film, cinematic and colourful, family comedy-adventure tone, expressive cartoon character animation with squash-and-stretch, detailed fur and fabric, soft global illumination, rich saturated colour, shallow depth of field, anamorphic widescreen framing, smooth professional camera work.
Setting: the Tomkin-Mobile's luxurious leather cockpit, a dazzling dashboard of switches, dials and glowing screens, a precision-engineered cup-holder bay lined with a tiny cushion, back seats, and a windscreen. Lighting: glowing dashboard light, flickering exterior light.
In the shot: Princess Holly, a tiny fairy princess about the height of a teacup, with a shimmering fairy-pink dress, iridescent wings like soap bubbles that catch the light, a little silver tiara, rosy cheeks, and a slender wand that fizzes with small irregular pink sparks; Tomkin, an anthropomorphic tabby cat who walks upright, slim and wiry, with burnt-orange "artisanal copper" fur and darker copper tiger stripes, bright emerald-green eyes, long expressive whiskers, a smug confident half-smile, brass welding goggles pushed up on his forehead, and a leather tool belt full of tiny gadgets.
Camera: Two-shot, Holly hopeful, Tomkin firm.
Action: Holly raises her wand hopefully toward the fortress; Tomkin turns and gives her a long, level look.
Dialogue: Princess Holly (soft, sweet, gentle young female voice, kind and nervous, apologising quickly, words tumbling out, hopeful) says: "Should I use my wand? I'm fairly sure I can do a cage-dissolving spell —" Tomkin (crisp, rapid-fire, precise male tenor with a clipped British accent; superior, exasperated, always certain he is the only rational being in the room, patient, firm) says: "Holly. What did we discuss?"
Sound effects: wand sparkle, door opening, ambience of purring engine, beeps and chimes.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
extension_prompt:
Continue this exact shot seamlessly: same characters, same designs, same setting, same lighting and same 3D animated style (Princess Holly, Tomkin).
Action: Holly lowers her wand sheepishly; Tomkin nods once and opens the door.
Dialogue: Princess Holly (soft, sweet, gentle young female voice, kind and nervous, apologising quickly, words tumbling out, sheepish) says: "That sabbatical means no wand unless the alternative is death or worse." Tomkin (crisp, rapid-fire, precise male tenor with a clipped British accent; superior, exasperated, always certain he is the only rational being in the room, determined) says: "Correct. Now let's get the squirrels."
Sound effects continue: wand sparkle, door opening.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
negative_prompt: live action, photorealistic humans, 2D flat animation, anime, sketch, subtitles, captions, on-screen text, watermark, logo, distorted faces, extra limbs, extra fingers, flicker, background music
